integrity: The proof derives all universal identities analytically. Standalone exact-symbolic and high-precision quadrature checks supplement the proof but do not establish universal assertions.
scientific_limitations: No claims concerning other trajectories, ambient three-dimensional normal dynamics, or nonlinear stability at unit multiplier. The 2011 closest precursor was accessible only through abstract/metadata, so publication-priority uncertainty remains.
scientific_scope: Affine angular coefficient within the cubic polynomial torus family with two invariant parallels; original-time periods and the nontrivial within-torus Floquet multipliers only.
title: Orthogonal period and Floquet controls for two parallel cycles on a cubic algebraic torus
